sizing: 10% of current equity, long-only, one position, no leverage, fractional units
entry: confirmed close signal, next observed open within 4 calendar days; crypto requires next adjacent hourly bar
brackets: signal ATR frozen, stop/target offsets from actual entry fill; gap stops at adverse open; both touched means stop first
periods: each period starts flat with prior indicator warmup; fixed rules, no parameter search
limitations: cached public data also used in earlier KAOS research; later period is chronological evaluation, NOT pristine unseen holdout; no Pine compiler or TradingView broker emulator used; no dividends, taxes, funding or options; USDT treated as USD; independent sleeves, not shared-account portfolio; broker minimum lot sizes not modeled
